note: One row per pull request number this library cites. The forge is outside this tree, so a number's disposition cannot be checked from a clone; this file is the dated snapshot that makes the check offline, and `node skills/forge-citations.mjs --refresh` prints the commands that re-take it. `readable_on_main` is clause 5 and it is a different kind of field: it is a git question, re-derived from `head` by any COMPLETE clone, locked because the evidence for a row that never landed expires when its branch is deleted. See the methodology sections on what a pull request citation owes.

Not a citation, and it is the one mention in this library whose correctness depends on the number NOT being lockable: it is the negative case in skills/forge-citations.test.mjs that proves an uncovered citation fails. It stays exempt if the forge ever issues row 999, because what is exempt is the mention and not the row.
